Package org.cyborgcats.ssm

Class StateXboxController

java.lang.Object
edu.wpi.first.wpilibj.GenericHID
edu.wpi.first.wpilibj.XboxController
org.cyborgcats.ssm.StateXboxController
All Implemented Interfaces:
Sendable
public class StateXboxController extends XboxController
An Xbox controller whose buttons are pre-wired to StateTrigger instances, enabling direct state scheduling from controller input without boilerplate polling code.
